title: 1997 UNOD declaring the programs illegal
summary: Steven Greer tells of 1997 UNOD declaring the programs illegal, about 1997 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that's what we did so that is 1997 I put a I think a two or threemonth clock on it

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who pushes for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, says that in 1997 he was involved in seeking a memo marked UNOD, short for "unless otherwise directed," that would declare the secret UFO programs illegal. He says he put a deadline of two or three months on it. If true, it would mean an official order was aimed at the secrecy itself.
